registration.method: Provisional independent width/height calibration to official 43.5m / 69m; depth uses vertical scale. Not survey georegistration.

surface.selection: Central portal, side-portal sculpture above 5.2m, western rose and kings gallery; side doors, sparse upper facade and tower candidates retain the authored fallback
surface.depth_filter: 3x3 median; inferred completion <=0.4m lower / <=0.2m upper; neighbor depth range <=0.6m

sparse_smoothing.note: Confidence-weighted depth regularization in sparse areas; inferred colour interpolation is smoothed, dense observations retained

rejected_tiles.reason: Insufficient direct support for a coherent upper surface; native comparison showed ragged depth and registration mismatch. Authored upper facade retained.
